title: Carrie Soto Is Back
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
summary: A retired tennis champion, disliked for her cold and fierce style, sees her record broken and decides at thirty-seven to come back to win it back. Her father coaches her, and the comeback is as much about her past as her game.
readIf: you want a story of ambition and stubborn pride, with a heroine who is difficult and compelling.
skipIf: you want a romance front and centre, as this is mainly about her sport, family and legacy.

pairings.reason: Same author and another story of a talented woman judged harshly for her ambition.
Another long look at obsessive creative or competitive drive and what it does to relationships.
Another determined woman refusing to shrink herself in a world built against her.
